# lifecycle

The session state machine, liveness, reconcile on start, shutdown policy, resume to idle.

Read first: `docs/features/lifecycle/spec.md`, `docs/features/lifecycle/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/actions-kill-is-idempotent` — A tmux session that is already gone counts as a successful kill; only a genuine tmux failure blocks End and Remove. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: actions, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/actions-kill-is-idempotent.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session` — Remove is allowed on a live session; it ends the session first and its dialog says so, then deletes the row and broadcasts sessionRemoved. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/actions-remove-allowed-on-live-session.md`
- `kb:adr/actions-serialized-per-session` — Launch, Resume, End and Remove hold a per-session-id lock, and the shell registry's global mutex becomes per-id. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: actions, lifecycle, surfaces) → `docs/adr/actions-serialized-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-run-d-holds-two-claude-sessions` — Run D types /clear in its idle window, so one MUSTER_SESSION spans two claude session ids and every status-line view names which one it means. (accepted, 2026-09-12; features: canary, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/canary-run-d-holds-two-claude-sessions.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-whole-object-session-upserts` — The state stream sends whole session objects on every change; the client replaces by id and sorts for display itself. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: connection, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/connection-whole-object-session-upserts.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding` — Every event is enveloped; a new session_id on an enveloped event is a clear-style rebind, a never-bound session binds on it, raw and status posts never bind. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind` — An enveloped event never rebinds a session backwards onto a Claude session_id it has already left; reordered stragglers apply without rebinding. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest` — Events carry no timestamps or order, so the daemon assigns a monotonic seq at ingest, returns 200 at once, and processes asynchronously. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode` — The launch form asks for model and starting permission mode; the mode seeds a last-known latch that the first hook corrects. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-form-seeds-model-and-permission-mode.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-start-in-explicit-flag-auto-fallback` — Start in keeps the four tabbed modes under Claude Code's labels, sends every one as an explicit flag, and falls back to auto when nothing is remembered. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/launch-start-in-explicit-flag-auto-fallback.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-alive-flag-not-a-state` — Liveness is an orthogonal alive flag, not a seventh state; a resumed session re-enters idle and a clear resets gauges but not identity. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-alive-flag-not-a-state.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-liveness-from-pane-existence` — Whether a session is alive is decided by tmux pane existence alone; SessionEnd is a hint and never sets or clears alive. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-liveness-from-pane-existence.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-liveness-writes-stop-at-shutdown` — Once Stop has begun, opportunistic liveness writes stop persisting; shutdown's own on-exit policy or the next boot's reconcile decides the final alive state. (accepted, 2026-09-16; features: lifecycle, surfaces) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-liveness-writes-stop-at-shutdown.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-migrations-add-tables-when-written` — A migration ships only the tables its milestone writes; the spec's schema sketch is not frozen into the first migration. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-migrations-add-tables-when-written.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-prompt-ordering-guards` — Events apply in seq order; Stop-family events close their prompt_id, a closed prompt never reopens, and an unseen prompt_id starts a turn. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-prompt-ordering-guards.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-reconcile-before-first-snapshot` — Reconcile on start runs synchronously before the first snapshot is served; unknown Muster-shaped tmux sessions are logged and never adopted. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-reconcile-before-first-snapshot.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-reconcile-converges-with-the-socket` — Reconcile decides row ownership from tmux list-sessions, repairs tmux_target from tmux, and never deletes a row whose pane is alive. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-reconcile-converges-with-the-socket.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session` — Resuming a dead session keeps the Muster row and its title and rebinds it to the new pane, matched on the unchanged Claude session_id. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-resume-rebinds-existing-session.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target` — A Muster session is identified by its tmux target; the Claude session_id is a mutable attribute that /clear replaces in the same pane. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-ids-monotonic-never-reused` — Session ids are allocated monotonically from a kv watermark and floored above every muster-N on the socket, so an id is never reissued. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: lifecycle, launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-ids-monotonic-never-reused.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-shutdown-leaves-sessions-running` — Sessions survive daemon shutdown by policy; the on-exit flag offers ask, leave and kill, with ask defaulting to leave without a terminal. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-shutdown-leaves-sessions-running.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-subagent-marked-events-not-stragglers` — A subagent-marked hook for a closed prompt moves the session to working or needs-input without reopening it; unmarked stragglers stay inert. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-subagent-marked-events-not-stragglers.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-activity-line-turn-aware-default-with-pref` — The activity line is turn-aware by default — your prompt while a turn is open, Claude's reply once it closes — with a pref for prompt, reply or both. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-activity-line-turn-aware-default-with-pref.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-order-daemon-owned-per-session-fields` — Rail order and pinned state are daemon-owned per-session fields with daemon-held invariants; the daemon persists and broadcasts, the client sorts. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-order-daemon-owned-per-session-fields.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-unread-inferred-from-live-terminal-client` — A session is unread when its turn closed while no terminal client was attached; the daemon infers it from its terminal registry and clears it on attach. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-unread-inferred-from-live-terminal-client.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-plan-located-by-transcript-scan` — The plan path is derived by scanning the transcript every hook names, on bounded triggers, and persisted on the session row; no watcher, no poll. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader, lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/reader-plan-located-by-transcript-scan.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-plan-sticky-once-named` — Once a session's plan has been named, a transcript scan that finds no plan keeps it and re-checks the file; only a scan naming another plan replaces it. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: reader, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/reader-plan-sticky-once-named.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-db-database-sql-hand-sql` — Database access is database/sql with hand-written SQL and embedded, numbered, forward-only migrations; no ORM. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/stack-db-database-sql-hand-sql.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-storage-sqlite-pure-go` — State is stored in SQLite through the pure-Go modernc driver in WAL mode; no cgo, no external database, no flat files. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle) → `docs/adr/stack-storage-sqlite-pure-go.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-terminal-backing-tmux` — Sessions run the real claude CLI inside tmux on a dedicated socket; the Agent SDK and bare daemon-owned PTYs were rejected. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/stack-terminal-backing-tmux.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-tmux-session-per-session` — Each Muster session is its own tmux session, named muster-<id>, because a tmux client attaches to a session and Tiles needs several live at once. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-tmux-session-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-dies-at-kill-shutdown-too` — A shell dies on exit, Remove, reconcile or a daemon shutdown with kill, which also counts shells in its prompt; leave leaves shells as it leaves sessions. (accepted, 2026-09-16; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-dies-at-kill-shutdown-too.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-is-attach-target-not-session` — A session may carry an ephemeral plain shell as a second attach target; the shell is not a session, no row, card, state or wire kind, forgotten on restart. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-is-attach-target-not-session.md`
- `kb:fact/background-completion-new-prompt-id` — A finished background task re-invokes the main agent as a UserPromptSubmit with a new prompt_id whose prompt begins <task-notification>. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-completion-new-prompt-id.md`
- `kb:fact/background-tasks-field` — Stop.background_tasks lists running subagents and backgrounded shells with status "running", [] when nothing is outstanding. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-tasks-field.md`
- `kb:fact/clear-mints-new-session-id` — /clear emits SessionEnd{reason:"clear"} for the old session_id, then SessionStart{source:"clear"} with a new id in the same pane. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.280; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/clear-mints-new-session-id.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-await-per-event` — SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolBatch and Stop hooks are awaited; PostToolUse does not hold the next tool; StopFailure is fire-and-forget. (active, 2026-09-23; verified 2.1.280..2.1.280; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-await-per-event.md`
